page_note: Page is structured as an extended ecclesial simile: catechumens=sweet land (segs 0-10), then a substrate cosmological exposition of the living soul's ascent via sun/moon to the land of light (segs 11-30), then application to holy church/catechumens (segs 31-36). The middle is genuine soul-eschatology substrate — luminaries as the only gate of escape, powers of heaven as defilers, land of light as final receiver. The editor has bracketed this substrate teaching with ecclesial application, using the substrate as a comparison-vehicle. Editorial fatigue is negative because the second half contains the substrate. Damage is high (54%).
